BiblicalUsage: Tamar sends Judah's seal to him as proof, and the seal speaks when she cannot. A seal marks what belongs to its owner, and Judah's own signet convicts him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can use the plain evidence of a thing to bring the truth out, even when the person holding it would rather stay silent.
